question.problem:
$$
{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,4)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{8}{3{y}^{11/3}}, & \,1\le y \\ 0, & \,\text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Let $X$ and $Y$ be continuous random variables. 
Find the conditional variance $\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=4]$ given that the conditional probability density function ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,4)$ is shown above and the corresponding expected value is ${\mu }_{Y|4}=\frac{8}{5}.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=x] & =\text{E}[(Y-{\mu }_{Y|x})^{2}\,|\,X=x] \\  & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2},\end{aligned}
$$

where 

$$
\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)\,\text{d}y.
$$

Therefore, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=4] & ={\int }_{-\infty }^{\infty }{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,4)\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }{y}^{2}\cdot \frac{8}{3{y}^{11/3}}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{8}{3{y}^{5/3}}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{\infty }\frac{8}{3}{y}^{-5/3}\,\text{d}y \\  & ={[\frac{8}{3}\cdot (-\frac{3}{2})\cdot {y}^{-2/3}]}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & ={[-\frac{4}{{y}^{2/3}}]}_{1}^{\infty } \\  & =0-(-4) \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=4] & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=4]-{\mu }_{Y|4}^{2} \\  & =4-{(\frac{8}{5})}^{2} \\  & =4-\frac{64}{25} \\  & =\frac{36}{25}.\end{aligned}
$$
